claims.text: The rate of dislocation climb governs high-temperature plastic strain in fusion plasma-facing tungsten alloys.
The rate of dislocation climb governs high-temperature toughness in fusion plasma-facing tungsten alloys.
Grain-boundary sliding enables dislocation climb in these tungsten alloys.
Segregation of a secondary element such as rhenium at tungsten grain boundaries facilitates dislocation climb and grain-boundary sliding.
Intentional grain-boundary solute enrichment increases high-temperature dislocation mobility through climb.
Increased dislocation mobility caused by segregation increases ductility and plastic strain.
Increased dislocation mobility caused by segregation increases energy absorption before fracture and therefore toughness.
The introduced solute will preferentially segregate to tungsten grain boundaries during heat treatment.
Grain-boundary solute segregation reduces the local energy barrier for dislocation climb.
Faster dislocation climb accelerates grain-boundary sliding during high-temperature loading.
Accelerated grain-boundary sliding delays crack initiation and propagation.
Samples with controlled solute segregation will exhibit higher high-temperature plastic strain rates than untreated baseline samples.
Samples with controlled solute segregation will absorb more energy before failure than untreated baseline samples.
The proposed mechanism is expected to operate in fine-grained tungsten alloys above approximately 1000°C.
Dislocation climb becomes rate-limiting in fine-grained tungsten alloys above approximately 1000°C.
The efficacy of segregation-mediated climb and sliding may be reduced at lower temperatures.
The efficacy of segregation-mediated climb and sliding may be reduced in highly coarse-grained tungsten alloys.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis and structural-mediator fields describe grain-boundary sliding as enabling or enhancing dislocation climb, whereas the mechanism field states that faster dislocation climb accelerates grain-boundary sliding. This reverses the asserted causal direction and leaves the mediator-to-mechanism ordering ambiguous.
